name: app-real-estate-app-flow-with-login-discover-account-and-notification-screens
title: Monochrome property app flow: onboarding, log in, discover listings, account, notifications and social sign-in on a dark base
whatItIs: A pale grey board with rows of white and black phones: an onboarding 'UNLOCK OVERSEAS OPPORTUNITIES' with a layered sea photo and a black Get Started, log in with phone or email tabs and a black Continue, a dark social sign-in block, a Discover screen with search, filter pills and photo listing cards with heart buttons and a price, an Account list with sections, a Notification sheet with green toggles and a Good Morning home.
whatItMeans: Clean and premium; black buttons and airy photos suit international property.
techniques: Use black pills for primary actions.
Split login into white form and dark social block.
Show listings with round heart buttons.
bestFor: Property and travel app UI kits

vocabulary.definition: A toggle switching between phone and email.
A photo card with price and specs.
A dark area of provider buttons.
A green switch for a notification type.
